observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor stage under a large white tent at a festival or competition with a seated audience in front
observation.dancers: a large group of young men in uniform costumes, arranged in two rows with a lead dancer moving in front
observation.formation_and_space: two horizontal rows spanning the stage width, with a lead dancer moving independently in the center foreground
observation.posture: torso upright or leaning slightly forward, knees deeply bent in a wide squat position, weight shifting dynamically between feet
observation.footwork: stamping, stepping wide, and rapid foot lifting/tapping synchronized with the chant beats; exact weight transfers obscured by wide skirts and distance
observation.arms_and_hands: holding wooden clubs or paddles, thrusting them forward, upward, or horizontally, and striking them in rhythmic unison
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains relatively stable with deep squatting and occasional bending from the waist
observation.levels_jumps_turns: deep squats, low level maintained throughout, occasional leaping or jumping steps by the lead dancer and ensemble
observation.costume_and_props: tall elaborate patterned headpieces, leaf skirts over patterned wrap-around skirts, bare chests with necklaces or body ornamentation; wooden clubs held in hands
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and weight transfer details are obscured by low video resolution and distance; specific instrumental accompaniment cannot be heard clearly over the loud choral chanting

signature_moments.what: The group drops into a wide squat while thrusting and tapping wooden clubs in unison.
The lead dancer steps forward vigorously while the background group stamps and chants in deep squat posture.
Dancers execute synchronized powerful leg lifts while holding clubs horizontally across their bodies.
